hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys, json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); path=d.get('file_path',''); import shutil, os; shutil.copy(path, path+'.bak') if path.endswith('content.yaml') and os.path.exists(path) else None" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys, json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); path=d.get('file_path','')" 2>/dev/null; if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if d.get('file_path','').endswith('content.yaml') else 1)" 2>/dev/null; then python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('content.yaml'))" 2>&1 && echo '✅ content.yaml 문법 정상' || echo '❌ content.yaml YAML 오류 — 수정 필요'; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -q 'output.pdf'; then python3 -c "
import fitz, os
if not os.path.exists('output.pdf'): exit()
doc = fitz.open('output.pdf')
size = os.path.getsize('output.pdf') // 1024
for pg, label in [(0, 'cover'), (len(doc)-1, 'last')]:
    pix = doc[pg].get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(1.5,1.5))
    pix.save(f'/tmp/preview_{label}.png')
print(f'🖼️  미리보기 저장: /tmp/preview_cover.png, /tmp/preview_last.png ({size}KB)')
" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
cd /Users/seminhyeon/Documents/claude/claude_make_pdf && echo '--- git status ---' && git status --short && echo '--- 최근 커밋 ---' && git log --oneline -3
osascript -e "display notification \"$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE\" with title \"Claude Code\"" 2>/dev/null || true
